descriptions.zh:
我们物种演化得愈发复杂。在群星之间寻得新的基因物质之后，我们已经准备好吸纳其中的一个部分。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们的辛勤劳动给我们带来了一些的选择。

无论做任何决定都将会影响到[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的子子孙孙们的未来。
descriptions.en:
Our species grows more complex. After scouring the stars for new genetic material, we are ready to adopt a new aspect. Thanks to the hard work of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] we have a choice.

Whatever decision we make will affect the future of the [Owner.GetSpeciesName] for generations to come.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工正在[Target.GetSpeciesName]定居点潜行，很快将能进入他们的建筑。我们需要耐心，而我们有的是耐心——最好的猎手总是从容不迫的。
descriptions.en: Our operatives are prowling [Target.GetSpeciesName] settlements and will soon gain access to their structures. All in good time. We are a patient breed; the best hunts are never rushed.

label.zh: 了解。
label.en: Acknowledged.

descriptions.zh: 猎物就在眼前。我们派遣去渗透[Target.GetName]的猎手非常有信心。他们将很快能进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]的居住区，宝贵的基因物质触手可及。
descriptions.en: Our prey is in sight. The hunters we sent to infiltrate the [Target.GetName] are confident. They will soon have access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory, and all of the precious DNA within.

label.zh: 好。
label.en: Good.

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工已经准备就绪。他们已经获得了进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]集居地的权限，并且准备好了合适的伪装。当然，像任何优秀的猎手一样，他们已经确保了多条撤离路线，有些比较体面，有些则不太体面。如果不得不使用下水道逃生，那可就太不幸了。
descriptions.en: Our agents are ready. They have gained access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory as well as proper disguises. Naturally, like any good hunter, they have secured multiple escape routes, some more agreeable than others. It will be unfortunate should we need to make use of the sewers.

label.zh: 开始行动！
label.en: Commence Operation!

descriptions.zh: 成功了！我们的特工带着一大堆基因物质满载而归，这样一来在下一次突变时我们又能确保获取巨大的优势了。也许我们还可以发展出对[From.Target.GetSpeciesName]的一些口味偏好。
descriptions.en: It is done! Our operatives have come away with a wealth of genetic material. We are sure to see great advancements when next we mutate. Perhaps we might even develop a taste for the [From.Target.GetSpeciesName].

label.zh: 棒极了。
label.en: Excellent.

descriptions.zh:
天空卫士汇报事态有令人警觉的进展。

最近在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!的传送门中探测到了一种极其微弱但绝对不会搞错的波动。在过去，类似的扰动总会带来一大波敌意的生物舰船。

如果这些数据真实可信，我们知道我下一波攻击会在数月之内到达。人民的生死存亡再一次交由我们的守卫者们保护了。
descriptions.en:
Our Skywatchers have reported an alarming development.

Subtle but unmistakable fluctuations were recently detected within the portal in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. In the past, similar disturbances have heralded waves of hostile biological vessels.

If these readings hold true, we can expect the next assault within a matter of months. The survival of our people may once again depend on the resolve of our defenders.

label.zh: 令人不安。
label.en: Disturbing.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes
is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们摧毁的生物舰队残骸在§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!不祥地飘荡着。虽然它们几乎成了扭曲的焦炭，但大部分有机物质仍然完好无损，为研究提供了难得的机会。

通过仔细的分析，我们也许能够揭开它们奇特结构的秘密——也许还能对它们出现的神秘传送门有所了解。
descriptions.en:
The debris left by the annihilated biological fleet drifts ominously through §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!. Though twisted and charred, much of the organic material remains intact, offering a rare opportunity for study.

With careful analysis, we may be able to uncover the secrets of their grotesque construction - and perhaps glean some insight into the enigmatic portal from which they emerge.

label.zh: 终于有进展了。
label.en: Progress at last.

descriptions.zh:
在费劲地研究了§Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!里留下的残骸后，我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]觉得他们应该找到了理解我们星系边缘耸立着的传送门的关键所在。

在这种生物的体内深处，发现了一种有机组织——它似乎与传送门的波动会发生共鸣。通过对该频率进行逆向工程，我们应该可以让自己穿越这个神秘的裂缝。

目前仍需要进一步研究，但我们反击的机会前所未有地触手可及了。
descriptions.en:
After painstaking study of the biological wreckage left in §Y[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] believe they may have the key to understanding the portal that looms at the edge of our system.

Deep within the creatures' tissue, an organic pattern has been identified - one that seems to resonate with the portal's fluctuations. By reverse-engineering this frequency, we should be able to traverse the enigmatic rift ourselves.

Further research will be necessary, but for the first time the possibility of taking the fight to the enemy is within reach.

label.zh: 棒极了。
label.en: Excellent.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
多亏了我们近期在§Y虫洞稳定§!领域的突破，我们现在得以一瞥§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!恒星系。

一支充满侵略性的生物舰队和一个戒备森严的恒星基地在另一头等着我们。建议谨慎行事。

我们找到了敌人的老巢。
descriptions.en:
Thanks to our recent breakthrough in §YWormhole Stabilization§! we have been offered a rare glimpse of the §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! system.

An aggressive fleet of biological vessels and a heavily fortified starbase await us on the far side. Extreme caution is advised.

We have found the cradle of the enemy.

label.zh: 令人不安。
label.en: Disturbing.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
盘踞在§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的舰队被摧毁了。在结束前一刻，我们收到了一个来自星系恒星基地的微弱信号，我们目前只翻译出的一条是：

§H“—全部失联！这是他们自己生产的舰船！无论你是谁，请救救我们！”§!

随后，所有的通讯就终止了。如果这真的是一场胜利，我们敌人的集结地给了我们一个战略击毁。也许，可以有一座深空擎天堡 I沐浴着§Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的光，来确保不会再有这样的敌人来威胁我们的文明。
descriptions.en:
The fleet guarding §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed. Just before the end, we received a haunting transmission from the system's starbase, one which we have only now translated:

§H" - lost all control! The ships are reproducing by themselves! Please, whoever you are, save us!"§!

Since then, all communication has ceased. If this is indeed victory, our enemy's staging ground offers a strategic opportunity. A new Deep Space Citadel I may one day shine in the light of §Y[starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!, ensuring that such a threat never imperils our civilization again.

label.zh: 终于，围攻结束了。
label.en: At last, our siege is lifted.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§!是一片露天坟地。

这颗星球上的优势物种完全被一种奇怪的侵略性生命形式所侵占。进一步的调查显示，它们并不是天然的有机体而是某种生物机器，而且并非建造而是生长而来。

不知是否有可能是这些生物的设计者被自己的创物反噬了？我们的敌人难道完全不知道对他们的行动毫无自知之明，甚至不连我们的存在都不知道吗？

只有一件事可以肯定：无论他们采取了什么措施来控制这场瘟疫，这都导致了他们自己以及他们自动制造的可憎之物的毁灭。
descriptions.en:
§Y[event_target:biomechanical_world_target.GetName]§! is an open grave.

The planet's dominant species was completely overrun by a strange and aggressive form of life. Further investigation revealed that these were no natural organisms, but rather biological machines, seemingly grown rather than built.

Is it possible that whoever engineered these creatures was overwhelmed by their own creation? Could our enemy have been completely unaware of their actions against us, or even of our existence?

Only one thing is certain: whatever measures they took to contain this plague destroyed them, along with their automated abominations.

label.zh: 所以我们并不是唯一的受害者……
label.en: Then we were not the only victims...

descriptions.zh:
我们在观察生物飞船攻击的过程中发现了一个令人不安的趋势。每一波攻击都显示出更高的协调性、适应性战术以及对我们防御系统的系统性试探。敏感器日志揭示了能量特征的变化和攻击优先级的调整，这些都是策略演变的证据。

这些生物，无论是通过本能还是集体智慧，正变得越来越强大。如果这种模式持续下去，下一波攻击将更加难以抵御。
descriptions.en:
We have witnessed a troubling trend in the biological ship attacks. Each wave displays improved coordination, adaptive tactics, and a methodical probing of our defenses. Sensor logs reveal shifts in energy signatures and targeting priorities, evidence of evolving strategies.

These creatures, whether through instinct or collective intelligence, are becoming more formidable. If this pattern continues, the next wave will be even harder to repel.

label.zh: 为守军祈祷。
label.en: Pray for the defenders.

tooltips.zh: 随着每一波次的到来，通过§Y古怪的传送门§!抵达的舰队实力都不断增强。
tooltips.en: With each successive wave, fleets arriving through the §YStrange Portal§! gain potency.

label.zh: 增强守军军力。
label.en: Strength to the defenders.

tooltips.zh: 随着每一波次的到来，通过§Y古怪的传送门§!抵达的舰队实力都不断增强。
tooltips.en: With each successive wave, fleets arriving through the §YStrange Portal§! gain potency.

descriptions.zh:
传送门另一端的遥测数据揭示了§Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!的一个关键进展：生物舰船和他们的孵化场都被一支未知的力量摧毁了。

尽管知道[GetInvadersLower]被葬送之后都非常高兴，但我们无法忽视另一支力量也许有一天就会控制住[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]恒星系的风险。

我们必须加快脚步确保这一战略要地不会落入到另一个敌人的手中。
descriptions.en:
Incoming telemetry from the portal reveals a critical development in §Y[event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName]§!: both the fleet of biological ships and their hatchery have been destroyed by an unknown force.

Even as we rejoice in knowing that the [GetInvadersLower] have met their end, we cannot ignore the risk that another power may one day seize control of the [event_target:starlit_sealed_system.GetName] system.

We must move quickly to secure this strategic location before we face yet another siege.

label.zh: 终于，围攻结束了。
label.en: At last, our siege is lifted.
